field_quantity_rules.note: CAUSALITY07 model time has no explicit SI mapping in the audited artifacts.
Counts and ordinal indices are dimensionless counts, not physical times.
Phase labels and sequences are categorical presentation or classification fields.
Reduced-state distance, drift proxy, and threshold 0.08 are not promoted to physical SI quantities.

claims.claim_text: The CAUSALITY07 reduced model output contains recurrence under the predefined phase sequence.
claims.claim_scope: QSB-CAUSALITY07 reduced Oregonator runner outputs only
claims.boundary_statement: This does not establish full chemical-state identity, physical causality, emergent time, or laboratory validation.

claims.claim_text: The reverse and scrambled control sequences were not accepted as complete cycles in the same classified time series.
claims.boundary_statement: The controls test detector selectivity only and do not validate physical direction.

claims.claim_text: Reduced-state recurrence is not complete chemical-state identity.
claims.boundary_statement: The model records recurrence in a reduced representation, not a whole-chemistry restart.

claims.claim_text: The global cycle order is predefined rather than independently reconstructed.
claims.boundary_statement: The predefined sequence is a segmentation condition and is not evidence of global uniqueness.

claims.claim_text: The state-vector distance threshold is explicit but not empirically calibrated in CAUSALITY07-03.
claims.boundary_statement: The threshold is a heuristic runner parameter, not a physical validation.
